description: Hello everyone I am Navya.Nagrajan based in Abudhabi , Uae. I am a 12 year old who is passionate to learn more about space as a whole. I have joined Nasa Space to discover projects and learn in the way.
summary: Nova Base is an interactive educational game developed for the young minds of the upcoming generation. This game takes players on a journey from Earth to Mars, so students can look through space. It is a three level game, teaching the player about survival and decision making on a Martian Outpost.
details:
Project name- Nova Base

Target of audience- Students/children aged 7-12

Project description- Nova Base is an interactive educational game developed for the young minds of the next generation. This game takes players on a journey from Earth to Mars, so students can look through space. It is a three level game, teaching the player about survival on Mars.

My main objective-

✨Introduce students/kids to the red planet (Mars)

✨Teach the importance of resources

✨Encourage curiosity in young minds

Expected Impact- NOVA BASE wants to help students step into the world of complex space slowly and step by step through fun games. It helps young minds to think like a real scientist and make decisions.
